verdict.rationale: Twenty ships native dashboards with real-time widgets. Charts are configurable by chart type, data source, filters, aggregation and grouping, and the docs explicitly cite pipeline health, team performance and revenue trends, so reporting happens in-app without exporting. Missing for 10: explicit conversion or funnel reporting, documented reporting on activity data (emails, calendar events, tasks), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard feature.
